text: This solution, Rangitata River 2019 Flood Recovery addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Environment Canterbury (ECan), Central government, Waka Kotahi NZ Transport Agency, KiwiRail, Transpower, Regional/district councils, Department of Conservation (DOC), Rangitata South Irrigation Ltd, Te Kete Tipuranga o Huirapa, and Local contractors. The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
